mc.text: This is to certify that Ahmad bin Ismail was examined on 2026-10-17 and is unfit for duty for 3 days, from 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-19 inclusive, due to Upper respiratory tract infection.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Good morning, Encik Ahmad. What brings you in today?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Morning doctor. I've had a sore throat and fever since two days ago. Also coughing, a bit of phlegm.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yes, runny nose, and my whole body is aching. I took Panadol at home, it helps a bit.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Any shortness of breath or chest pain?

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Do you have any drug allergies?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yes, penicillin. I got a rash last time.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, noted. Any long-term illness or regular medication?

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Let me check you. Temperature is 38.2. Throat is red, tonsils are slightly enlarged but no pus. Lungs are clear. Pulse 92, BP 124 over 78.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: This looks like a viral upper respiratory tract infection. You don't need antibiotics for now. I'll give you paracetamol 1 gram four times a day as needed for fever, cetirizine 10 milligrams at night for the runny nose, and bromhexine 8 milligrams three times a day for the phlegm.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Doctor, can I get MC? I work at the factory, I can't go in like this.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Yes, I'll give you MC for two days, today and tomorrow. Drink plenty of water and rest.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: If the fever goes above 39, or you get breathless, or it's not better in 3 days, come back.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Okay doctor. I'm under the AIA panel from my company.
